review:
A farmyard zombie apocalypse: a possessed hen performs rituals that pull in multipliers up to 666x, with a 6,666x ultimate offering at the top. Underneath, it's a cluster-pays game.

Three scatters start the Super Bonus: 12 free spins and three Replicator Cells to begin with, and any cell multipliers you've built in the base game carry straight over. Two scatters add three more spins. There are Bonus Boost and Hell Spins modes too. Very high volatility, 96.23% RTP, bonus about once every 236 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
